title: RoboLiveMem: Is Robot Memory Solved When the World Does Not Wait?
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce RoboLiveMem, a benchmark that runs the same memory tasks twice, once with the world paused while the model thinks and once with the world running.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing memory benchmarks cannot answer this question, because they pause the simulator while the model thinks: nothing can change during a decision, so whatever the robot remembers is still true when it acts.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It contains 29 task families in three tiers, from 16 realistic BEHAVIOR-1K scenes of homes, workshops and a restaurant to controlled ManiSkill tasks.
